A FOREST UNDER SIEGE

Canopy
Vanguard

The forest is your stronghold. Its branches, your escape.
Break the invading warband before they find your people.

LEFT THUMB

Drag to move. A short tap interacts with the forest.

RIGHT THUMB

Drag to look. Tap near an enemy for a snapshot. Hold still to draw, then release. Advanced techniques are learned in the village.

TURN UP THE SOUND

Goblins call out when they choose a path, spot prey, attack, rally, taunt, or die.

The game will request fullscreen landscape where your browser allows it. Both touch zones remain active together.

Turn your device sideways

Canopy Vanguard is played in landscape. Your left thumb moves; your right thumb looks and fires.
